task.prompt: Set an execution breakpoint at the code address the console expression PlayerX+2 evaluates to, with breakpoint_at forced to read its ref as an expression rather than as a symbol or an address.

lines: M55: CANNOT breakpoint_at refuses expression refs (by "expr"), so a breakpoint on the value of PlayerX+2 must be declared as a register point instead.
M55: CANNOT breakpoint_at refuses an expression as a place, so a console expression cannot be declared as a breakpoint ref.
